title: CultureScope: A Dimensional Lens for Probing Cultural Understanding in LLMs
benchmark_measurement: Knowledge of religious norms, values, and practices as a component of broader cultural understanding. The evaluation measures factual recall and contextual application related to the 'Religion' dimension within the CultureScope framework.
findings: Models exhibited significant performance differences on religion-related questions depending on the language used. For the Spanish cultural context, nearly all models performed well on religion-related questions posed in Spanish but performed poorly on the same questions when posed in English. This highlights that model performance on cultural topics like religion is highly language-dependent.
